# `prefer-testing-expect-approx`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a manual absolute-difference floating-point assertion.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`expectApproxEqAbs` communicates tolerance semantics and provides a more useful
failure message.

## When it fires

It applies when the analyzer recognizes the standard absolute-difference
comparison shape.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

test "approx" {
    const actual: f32 = 0.1 + 0.2;
    const expected: f32 = 0.3;
    try std.testing.expect(@abs(actual - expected) < tolerance);
}

const tolerance = 0.001;
```
